briefings.headline: Stay disciplined; hunt Ureña’s fastball
briefings.message: Walbert Ureña is the medium-confidence expected starter. He leans on his changeup, so stay patient and attack fastballs when they enter your hunt area. Travis Bazzana and Rhys Hoskins lead the listed matchup opportunities, but their matchup samples are small. Make Ureña locate the changeup rather than chasing it. Be ready for Drew Pomeranz as the available left-handed bullpen arm.
reminders: Bazzana: look for fastballs; matchup samples are small.
Hoskins: hunt fastballs and beware offspeed; the offspeed advantage uses small samples.

briefings.headline: Cantillo sets the tone; keep the ball out of their damage zones
briefings.message: Joey Cantillo is the only ready starter; plan for 5.0 innings with an 85-pitch limit. Use changeups below the zone to Trout and Adell, and avoid predictable fastballs to them. Work breaking pitches below the zone to Neto; change speeds and locate carefully against Grissom. Schanuel and Josh Lowe are matchup targets, but both splits are small samples. If Cantillo exits early, use Pallette for length, then bridge with rested middle relief. Save rested leverage arms for close spots and keep limited arms for necessity or low leverage.
reminders: Late lead: Festa, Sabrowski, then Smith.
Use Gaddis and Holderman ahead of limited arms.
Herrin is limited; Aleman is limited.
